whoami.roleDescription: I build whatever I feel like building - no niche, no roadmap.
whoami.intro:
Most of it ends up in TypeScript. Discord bots and client plugins are what I touch the most, but a project only has to sound fun to get started - sometimes a small static page, sometimes a tool only I will ever use.

No stack by default: a framework, a build step or a dependency has to earn its place.
whoami.whatIdo: whatever the current idea is. TypeScript when it pays off, vanilla JS when it doesn't, and a build step only if the project actually needs one.
whoami.experience: self-taught and learning by shipping - everything here started as something I wanted for myself.
whoami.alsoGoodAt: sometimes it is complete nonsense nobody needs. I build it anyway, because I felt like it.
